d: Namaste, Kia India just surprised us by bringing in Sorento at a price that makes car a no brainier. Starting at Rs 27.99 lakh, Sorento will be offered in both Diesel and Petrol. Both the petrol and diesel engine options will be offered with automatic and all-wheel drive. Logical pricing, according to Kia, is possible because the assembly of the car is not limited to bigger parts, but some of the child parts are being localized. The variants that are on offer make it look more mouth-watering.
